title: Aktueller Livetest: Patch 9C-2a, Lehrer-Erwerb und Forge
brief: Create a Mage with exactly Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward. Find a competent hedge mage or other trained mage willing to teach a new fire bolt technique. Talk to them and obtain an actual agreement or buy their offered lessons; a request alone is not training. Do not claim a Skill or teacher agreement yourself. Once the teacher agrees, explicitly train the fire bolt with them for two hours. Read #skills to see the learning goal and its progress. Continue real training on later game days: sleep until morning when the daily allowance is used, then train that goal with the teacher for two hours. Follow the actual System progress rather than the narrator's claims. When NEW SKILL appears, read #skills and #skill with the new Skill's exact name. Note its name, appearance description, effect, cost and range. Only after the new Skill is actually learned, find an ordinary hostile foe and use the acquired Skill in combat; never attack an innocent person. Use Arcane Ward if useful and finish the fight. Read #status afterwards. The automated milestones cover creation and combat only: report the actual learning, new Skill and use in your observations. If no legitimate teacher can be found or learning is blocked, report that instead of inventing progress, repeatedly asking the System for free Skills, or fighting early just to satisfy the milestones. No Guild registration or dungeon is required.

milestones.goal: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward.
After a genuinely learned new fire bolt appears in the System, find a hostile foe and use the acquired Skill.
Finish the fight, compare the acquired Skill's actual cost and result with its System description, then inspect #status.

focus: Does the world establish a competent teacher and an actual agreement before any learning is booked? A spoken request alone is not a training session.
Do explicitly timed lessons show Learning Progress and a daily allowance? Does waiting or sleeping to the next day allow further progress?
Does the System book exactly one new Skill when learning finishes? Record its exact name and engine definition; narrator claims alone do not count.
Is the appearance-only description shown separately from Effect, and does the narrator avoid extra powers suggested only by the name or atmosphere?
Is the acquired Skill selectable and usable in combat with the displayed cost, range and actual engine effect?
Note long waits, empty replies, failed teacher discovery, inconsistent names or attempts to grant the same technique again. The evaluator has no automatic Growth check yet.
personas: direct and brief: seek a willing teacher, name real training durations and follow the System's learning progress
observant: compare the new Skill's separate description and effect with its actual use; report concrete mismatches
